تفترسي (form VIII)
# تَفْتَرِسِي (taftarisī) /taf.ta.ri.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
# تُفْتَرَسِي (tuftarasī) /tuf.ta.ra.siː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِفْتَرَسَ (iftarasa)
